description: This file defines the 'File' class within the ZipStream namespace, responsible for handling ZIP file entries including processing paths, data, headers, footers, and stream management.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents a ZIP file entry, managing data processing, headers, footers, and stream handling for ZIP archive creation.

methods.name: processPath
methods.description: Processes a file path, reading and processing file data or stream depending on size.

methods.name: processData
methods.description: Processes raw data, computes CRC, optionally compresses, and prepares for ZIP entry.

methods.name: addFileHeader
methods.description: Creates and sends the ZIP file header for this entry.

methods.name: filterFilename
methods.description: Sanitizes filename for Windows compatibility and encoding.

methods.name: addFileFooter
methods.description: Creates and sends the data descriptor footer for this ZIP entry.

methods.name: processStream
methods.description: Processes a data stream, handling compression and data reading.

methods.name: deflateData
methods.description: Compresses data chunks and updates CRC and length counters.

methods.name: processStreamWithZeroHeader
methods.description: Processes stream with zero header, adding header, reading, and footer.

methods.name: readStream
methods.description: Reads data from stream in chunks, optionally compressing and sending.

methods.name: getCdrFile
methods.description: Generates the central directory record for this file.

methods.name: getTotalLength
methods.description: Returns total length of the ZIP entry.

methods.name: dosTime
methods.description: Converts UNIX timestamp to DOS timestamp format.

methods.name: buildZip64ExtraBlock
methods.description: Builds ZIP64 extension block if needed for large files.

methods.name: processStreamWithComputedHeader
methods.description: Processes stream with computed header, handling incremental compression.
